permission_hook.description: Opt-in: kharos may install a PermissionRequest hook in a repository, which answers permission prompts in its cloud sessions, and kharos logs the hook's decisions as it reads the session logs. See docs/permissions.md.

preflight_auto.description: Opt-in automatic permission preflight, effective only while permission_hook is on: at each launch kharos writes the allow patterns and prefix rules the preflight suggests to a side branch kharos/<id> and starts the session there (the organization's ask rules are also mirrored while a remembered mirror confirmation matches its managed settings); the branch a profile launches from is never changed, and the side branch is deleted when the session is closed. See docs/permissions.md.

permission_unblock.description: Opt-in, with preflight_auto and a remembered confirmation that matches the organization's managed settings: the side branch of each launch gets the unblock preset, which allows every permission prompt in its cloud session. Refused when the organization disabled bypass mode; deny rules are never touched. See docs/permissions.md.

account_mode.description: What the person chose in /kharos:setup, once: start this Claude account's sessions in auto mode (written to its user settings after an approved diff) or leave the mode as it is. See docs/setup.md#launch-approval.

repo.description: One GitHub repository: https://github.com/owner/name or owner/name.

revision.description: Branch or tag the session starts from.

environment.description: Cloud environment id; /kharos:setup fills it in from the environment picked by name.

allowed_tools.description: Sent as the routine's allowed_tools. It neither allows nor restricts anything: permission prompts come from the repository's .claude/settings.json (see docs/permissions.md).

connectors.description: false sends clear_mcp_connections, so the session gets none of the account's connectors.

environment_name.description: The environment's name as the account lists it; /kharos:setup writes it when the person picks the environment by name.

permissions.description: What the person chose in /kharos:setup for this profile's permission prompts: as-is or unblock-all. auto-unblock is an older name of unblock-all, read as it; standard, hook, standard+hook, auto-preflight and unblock are modes of earlier versions, read as as-is.

account.description: A hash of the Claude account that set up the profile, never the login itself; an environment belongs to one account, and this file is shared by every account on the machine.

quiet_end_min.description: Minutes of quiet after a turn closed without an end mark, while a background task it started may still wake it, before kharos warns (session.quiet_unmarked).

unmarked_end_min.description: Minutes of quiet after a turn closed without an end mark, with no background task left that could wake it, before kharos asks the session once whether it finished; with no end mark as long again after that, it warns (session.quiet_unmarked).

max_open.description: How many launches may be open at once; /kharos:setup asks it once. Each open session spends plan usage, and the service publishes no limit of its own.

events.description: Event classes (progress, needs_you, terminal), event names, or * for all.

webhook_env.description: Environment variable that holds the webhook URL. The default is the plugin's sensitive slack_webhook option, kept in the keychain.
